steps.title: Enter JSON
steps.description: Paste or type your JSON data into the input editor. You can also upload a JSON file.

steps.title: Validate
steps.description: The tool automatically validates your JSON. If there are errors, they will be highlighted with line numbers.

steps.title: Format
steps.description: Click 'Format' to beautify your JSON with proper indentation and spacing.

steps.title: Minify
steps.description: Click 'Minify' to remove all whitespace and reduce file size.

steps.title: View Tree
steps.description: Toggle tree view to see a visual representation of your JSON structure.

steps.title: Export
steps.description: Copy the formatted JSON, download as a file, or share via URL.
